paragraphs: Rav Naḥman bar Pappa, Bava Metzia 80b, 81a. He sowed seeds that did not sprout; he prayed and rain came, Elu Terefot 60b. Naḥum bar Pappa in R. Elazar HaKappar's name, Yoma 67a. Rav Pappa bar Naḥman was perhaps his son. גא״י [provisionally Gelilot Eretz Yisrael] and Benjamin's Travels say Rav Natan and Rav Naḥman bar Pappa were buried at Pumbedita.
